scope: All 45 effective canonical contracts and every merged v5 typed alias; deterministic prompt preflight only, with no rendered-pixel or population-preference claim.
limitations: Prompt and audit PASS proves literal contract binding, not successful pixels.
Image research is qualitative and does not establish prevalence or popularity.
Negative visual confounds remain pixel-review checks, not lexical bans.
Community-only etymology remains low confidence and cannot authorize stereotype inference.
